title: AI Loop Soft Retry on Parse / Decision Failure Instead of Hard Stop
goal: When the picker returns None (parse fail, empty text, or unrecoverable hop loop exit), the assessment loop currently sets status=stopped with reason no_registered_runner_candidate and halts the run. Replace this with bounded soft retry (max 2 attempts with fresh per-call backoff) so a single bad output does not kill an otherwise healthy run.
scope: Modify api/app/services/assessment_loop.py advance_assessment_loop to detect parse-fail / None-candidate distinctly from genuine exhaustion. On parse-fail, retry up to 2 times with the same context. On exhaustion (no candidate after retries), THEN set stopped.
generation_reason: Observed 2026-05-15: one JSON parse failure on iteration 17 caused the loop to set status=stopped/no_registered_runner_candidate. Manual operator intervention required to resume. With structured outputs (task #380) the parse-fail class disappears, but other transient failures (network blip on http_fetch, momentary credit pause) should also not kill an entire run.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Retry logic only. Do NOT change tool definitions, the schema, or the system prompt.
constraints.max_retries: Hard cap retries per advance at 2. Beyond that, mark loop stopped with descriptive reason (e.g. picker_retry_exhausted).
constraints.no_infinite_loops: Each retry attempt must increment a counter visible in loop_state so the operator can see retry history.

success_criteria: Parse-fail or empty-text from picker triggers retry, not stop.
Retry attempts visible in loop_state under retries_this_advance.
After 2 failed retries, loop sets stopped with reason picker_retry_exhausted (distinguishable from no_registered_runner_candidate).
Unit test simulates 1 fail + 1 success per advance and proves loop continues.
Unit test simulates 3 fails per advance and proves loop sets retry_exhausted after the third.

acceptance_criteria: Loop survives 1 transient picker failure per advance.
Loop stops decisively after 2 consecutive picker failures on a single advance.
No regression on the happy-path live picker test.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.

out_of_scope: Auto-restart of fully-stopped runs (operator action, not loop).
